common.tagline: The Carbon Credit Standard. Verified. Onchain. DeFi-native.

hero.lead: CCM is a unit. One tonne of CO₂e — verified once, retired once, fluid in between. The CCM Network is the onchain infrastructure that lets it travel.

readout.label: atmosphere · readout
readout.ppmCaption: atmospheric CO₂, May 2026 · NOAA Mauna Loa

market.label: § 2 · market opportunity
market.lead: The voluntary carbon market is forecast at 25× growth by 2030 and 125× by 2050. McKinsey, the World Bank, and IPCC all agree — provided the market actually works.

items.b: From an IPCC-aligned standard down through MRV, oracles, VVB consensus, and an onchain registry — eight layers defining how a tonne of CO₂e becomes verifiable.
A single measurement: 1 ccm = 1 tCO₂e. Issued as an ERC-1155 NFT with vintage, grade, and provenance baked into its metadata.
An ERC-20 token, 1:1 backed by NFTs in a non-custodial vault. Wrap in for liquidity, unwrap out for retirement. The vault is the only source of truth.

problem.label: § 3 · what broke
items: Provenance lost in PDF registries; spreadsheets traded by phone.
Same tonne sold across registries with no shared ledger.
Long settlement, fragmented brokers, no native price discovery.
A nature-based credit prices identically to a DAC tonne.

wrap.label: § 2 · dual representation
wrap.lead: Every CCM exists in one of two forms — an ERC-1155 NFT (source-of-truth) or an ERC-20 $CCM (AMM-ready). The wrap is 1:1, non-custodial, reversible.
wrap.nftMeta: vintage 2026 · grade CCM-A · DAC · project 0x7f…3a · vvb 5/7 · tCO₂e per token: 1
wrap.tokenMeta: fungible · AMM (Uniswap, Curve) · collateral (vault lending) · composable (12 protocols)

arch.label: § 4 · architecture
arch.lead: L5 NFT = traceability · L6 Token = liquidity · L7 DeFi = composability. Each layer ships independently; swap one and the rest still stand.

mining.label: § 5 · ccmine
mining.lead: Proof of Carbon Removal/Reduction (PoCR). Bitcoin's PoW hash is replaced by verifiable reduction activity as the issuance unit. The hub below shows live mints across the network.

tokenomics.label: § 1 · tokenomics
tokenomics.lead: ERC20Capped enforced at the contract level — no mint function survives deployment. Allocation runs 40% mining, 18% foundation, 10% strategic, 9% liquidity, 8% treasury, 5% each for public sale, staking, and team.

vs.lead: Earlier onchain carbon projects merely tokenized credits from external registries. CCM mints, verifies, and grades onchain from issuance.

manifesto.h1: The day CCM becomes an everyday unit — that is the infrastructure we are building toward.

ccmine.lead: Proof of Carbon Removal/Reduction. Operate hardware, attest data, or store registry shards — earn from every verified ton.

tokenomics.lead: 5,000,000,000 hard cap. ERC20Capped enforced. 40% to mining, 9% liquidity, 18% foundation. veCCM accrues protocol revenue.

roadmap.lead: From Standard v1.0 to UNFCCC Article 6 alignment. Phase 0 done. Mainnet 2026 Q3. DeFi at scale 2027 H1.

defi.lead: Wrap, vault, lend, fractionalize, retire, insure, index. CCM × DeFi composability — Uniswap, Curve, Aave, Pendle, OpenSea, Sudoswap.

problem.label: what broke
problem.lead: Opaque registries, double counting, no liquidity, and no grade signal. Each one is a design flaw in the market, not an accident of it.

trinity.label: trinity
trinity.lead: A network that sets the standard, a unit that measures one verified tonne, and a token that lets it move. Bitcoin’s layering, applied to carbon.

wrap.label: dual representation
wrap.lead: Every CCM exists in one of two forms — an ERC-1155 NFT that carries provenance, or an ERC-20 $CCM that trades. The wrap is 1:1, non-custodial and reversible.
wrap.deeper: Unwrap modes, FIFR and the invariant

grades.label: grading
grades.lead: Four grades keyed to permanence and MRV tier. A DAC tonne and a cookstove tonne are both one CCM, but they are never the same CCM.

tokenomics.label: tokenomics
tokenomics.lead: ERC20Capped at the contract level. Forty percent goes to miners over ten years; every other bucket vests on a schedule or sits under DAO control.
